summary: Tested 8 assertions: all 8 passed. Navigation flows (dashboard→brief, direct URL, back to dashboard) all work correctly. Brief page loads existing data server-rendered without triggering generation API calls. Company metadata renders completely with no broken fields. Completion indicator accurately shows 'Complete' for fully populated brief. Invalid company IDs show a user-friendly error page. Data aggregation is server-side with no client-side fetch orchestration.
